source.harvest_mismatch_note: The harvested file contained the a03J04 proof and was removed. No worked informal solution for a03J05 is currently available.

closer_note: Closed the frequency-zero case, proved pointwise and integral evenness, and proved global integrability of every oscillatory kernel by domination with (1+x^2)^-1. The positive-frequency transform evaluation still requires an unavailable Fourier-transform, Laplace-inversion/Fubini, or residue-contour bridge.
